# Test cases
def test_process_student_data():
    students = [
        {"name": "Alice", "grades": [85, 90, 88], "active": True},
        {"name": "Bob", "grades": [75, 80, 82], "active": True},
        {"name": "Charlie", "grades": [90, 95, 92], "active": False},
    ]

    result = process_student_data(students)
    expected_names = ["Alice", "Charlie"]
    expected_avg_1 = round(87.67, 2)
    expected_avg_2 = round(92.33, 2)

    assert len(result) == 2
    assert result[0]["name"] in expected_names
    assert result[1]["name"] in expected_names
    assert round(result[0]["average_grade"], 2) in [expected_avg_1, expected_avg_2]
    assert round(result[1]["average_grade"], 2) in [expected_avg_1, expected_avg_2]

    print("Exercise 10: Complex Data Processing - PASSED")
